visual_description: The image displays the official seal of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), an agency within the U.S. Department of Commerce. The circular logo features a stylized white bird in flight against a blue background, symbolizing air and sea. Encircling the central design are two concentric rings of text: the outer ring reads "NATIONAL OCEANIC AND ATMOSPHERIC ADMINISTRATION," and the inner ring states "U.S. DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE." The acronym "NOAA" appears prominently in bold white letters at the center top.
